stage1_spec_compliance.summary: RAG delivery and settings governance surfaces are implemented and tested, but async/lifecycle robustness has gaps under concurrent refresh and long-lived sessions.

fallback.command: pnpm --filter @text2sql/frontend run test -- tests/unit/chat-rag-sync-stream-consistency.spec.tsx tests/unit/chat-panel.spec.tsx tests/unit/rag-delivery-panel.spec.tsx tests/unit/rag-delivery-section.spec.tsx tests/unit/settings-page-governance-visibility.spec.tsx

findings.title: `loadRagView` allows out-of-order async completions to overwrite newer settings/RAG state

evidence.detail: `loadRagView` performs multiple async requests and commits state without any request token or cancellation guard.
Second async phase (`getRun` + `fetchRagReplayCompleteness`) can resolve after a newer invocation and still call `setRagRun`, `setRagReplay`, `setRagError`, `setRagLoading`.
Refresh button can trigger repeated overlapping invocations (`loadRagView`) while previous one is in flight.

findings.impact: Rapid refreshes or overlapping post-mutation reloads can render stale run/quality/foundation data, creating operator-visible state rollback in governance views.
findings.suggested_fix: Introduce a monotonic request version (`useRef<number>`) or AbortController per `loadRagView` call; before each state commit, bail out if the call is stale. Also disable refresh-triggering actions while `ragLoading` is true to avoid request storms.

findings.title: Module-scoped section state map is unbounded and collides for runs without IDs

evidence.detail: Fallback key `__unknown-run__` causes multiple unknown-run messages to share one persisted expand/collapse state bucket.

findings.impact: Long-lived sessions can accumulate stale UI state, and unknown-run messages can leak collapse state between unrelated message cards.
findings.suggested_fix: Scope manual section state to component instance (or a bounded LRU keyed by stable message/run identity), and avoid a shared sentinel key for unknown runs.

residual_risks: No dedicated concurrency test currently asserts stale-request suppression for overlapping `loadRagView` invocations.
testing_gaps: Add a unit test that simulates two overlapping `loadRagView` calls with reversed completion order and asserts only the latest response mutates state.
Add a lifecycle test for `RagDeliveryPanel` ensuring manual section state does not leak between messages lacking runId.
